paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Accuracy comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of next token prediction for two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, over a range of training steps. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The x-axis, labeled "Step", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 60,000, with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The plot contains two lines: one in blue, representing Ex1 Accuracy, with circle markers and a solid line style, and another in cyan, representing Ex2 Accuracy, also with circle markers and a solid line style. The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 and increases to 0.40 at 5,000 steps, then remains steady at 0.40 from 10,000 to 60,000 steps. The cyan line starts at 0.10 and increases to 0.25 at 5,000 steps, then steadily rises to 0.38 at 60,000 steps, with a notable increase between 15,000 and 20,000 steps.
